content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near the O2 arena in London ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and a lorry. Firefighters from the London fire brigade responded to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, bringing the blaze under control after about an hour with 25 personnel on scene and no injuries reported. The fire followed a pre‑planned filming event close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas the following week. The brigade posted on X that the fire at the Silvertown yard is now under control, noting the van was destroyed and most of the car and lorry were damaged, with no injury reports. They added that the fire started from a controlled explosion on the set that spread, and crews will stay until evening. The yard is also near London’s cable car link over the Thames, and a Met police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
